whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm packages.lock.json no longer carries a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
